svg.title: Verification receipt
svg.desc: The primary campaign ran all 125 upstream task types with the five seeds from the pinned BrowserGym configuration in each of two arms: 1,250 episodes. Both arms used fresh Codex sessions with the same model and prompts. The browser protocol was adapted to filtered MCP tools.
